cases.name: consumed_alias_read
cases.source: resource c: Catalog; model m: Planner; decision d() ! { Snapshot(c), Infer(m), Explore(c), Commit(c) } { let b = snapshot c; let p = propose m<Patch>(b, "x", 1); let t = explore x in p from b { let s = simulate c.apply(x); measure n: Int = c.unresolved_units(s); }; let a = select t minimize n; let alias = a; let done = commit a to c; return commit alias to c; }

cases.name: simulation_inside_unknown_call
cases.source: resource c: Catalog; model m: Planner; decision d() ! { Snapshot(c), Infer(m), Explore(c), Commit(c) } { let b = snapshot c; let p = propose m<Patch>(b, "x", 1); let t = explore x in p from b { let s = simulate c.apply(x); check c.absent(simulate c.apply(x)) else "bad"; measure n: Int = c.unresolved_units(s); }; let a = select t minimize n; return commit a to c; }
